verdicts.why: In The Defenders #8 Danny tells the others Matt's one parting request to him was 'Protect my city', and he ends trying to be the protector Daredevil was; with Matt presumed dead this adds to their tie.
The scene's dialogue has Colleen say Danny owns the hospital Misty is in and has connections there to get her back up and running, so the current text is right; the bionic arm comes later.
Gunner dies of his wounds after the Anvil fight in The Punisher S1#5, so 'whom he helps save' is false; the new line is true.
After DHS fakes his death at the swap, Lieberman reunites with his family and tries to explain everything in S1#12, a clear turn from watching in secret.
Rawlins found David out and had Wolf deal with him before the story starts; in S1#11 he has Sarah and Zach kidnapped and says Wolf told him David was dead. The new text matches.
In S4#5 Davis and Prince reach Coulson and May inside South Ridge Penitentiary and hand them I.C.E.R.s, so the connection starts there.
Blake never meets or speaks to Matt; his only tie is spinning Fisk's line against Daredevil on Fisk's orders, which is knowing about him, not a connection with huge consequences of his own.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#9
value.text: Trapped in a time loop, Enoch removes the part that keeps him alive so the team can fix the time drive, and Deke uses it to make the repair as Enoch dies.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Chronicom whose sacrifice lets Deke fix the time drive.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who fixes the time drive with the part Enoch dies giving up.

verdicts.why: Enoch's death in S7#9 is a real stage with Deke there, but the sources do not show Deke thanking him; Deke takes comfort in the sacrifice and then fixes the time drive with Simmons as Enoch dies.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
value.text: Having lost the grandfather he knew, Deke works beside the Fitz who survived in space, and the two start to bond.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Deke's grandfather. The Fitz who survives starts to bond with him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's grandson, who bonds with the Fitz who survives.

verdicts.why: A new phase with the surviving Fitz is real, but that Fitz has never met Deke (he is confused when Deke hugs him in S6#9); their bonding is shown in S6#10, so 'reunited' is wrong and the stage belongs where the bonding happens.

value.text: Diamondback bursts into the meeting at Colon's gym and kills the other crime bosses, but spares Colon and tells him to warn the others.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A gang boss Diamondback spares when he kills the others at his gym.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The gun supplier who kills the other bosses in Colon's gym but spares him.

verdicts.why: There is no 'buy or die' exchange; in S1#9 Diamondback kills the other bosses at Colon's gym, spares Colon over his cousins and tells him to warn the others. The proposed motive (bosses no longer buying his guns) is not in the sources; he says he was insulted not to be invited.
At the end of S1#7 Diamondback, who knows Luke as Carl, shoots him with a Judas bullet; the brother reveal comes in S1#8.
In S2#11 Madani joins Karen in helping Frank; they examine the three women's bodies, learn Russo executed them, and Karen pulls the fire alarm while Madani sneaks Frank out.
In S2#2 Krista finds Madani tormenting Russo, insists he cannot be faking and sends her out; they clash again in S2#3, well before S2#12.
Krista never truly helps Madani; she plays friend to pump her for information on Frank for Russo, and in S2#12 Madani finds proof Russo stayed with her and pushes her out a window in their fight.
In S2#7 a flashback shows James coaching Madani through the 'least worst' lie, and in the present James tells her to stay out of it and let Castle and Russo kill each other.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#1
value.text: Domingo Colon meets Mariah and Cottonmouth at Harlem's Paradise about their new partnership, and Mariah rebuffs his idea that his money buys him political protection.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A councilwoman who rebuffs Colon's idea of buying her protection.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A gang boss Mariah rebuffs when he wants political protection.

verdicts.why: The S1#1 meeting is real (Colon calls Mariah's help a get-out-of-jail-free card and she says she does not make that kind of deal), but the proposed card lines are swapped: the line on Colon's card must describe Mariah.
In JJ S3#8 Dorothy gets Thembi Wallace to interview Jessica about Sallinger, then tells her she is proud of both her daughters; Sallinger murders her that night.
In LC S2#13, angry that Luke took Mariah's club, D.W. tells him Pop's is Switzerland: he can get a haircut there but cannot talk shop, and Luke complies.
In AC S2#9 Jarvis blames Peggy for Ana's shooting and says everyone around her dies, then reveals Ana cannot have children and Peggy apologizes; a clear falling-out and reconciliation.
At the end of Defenders #6 Gao watches Elektra kill Alexandra and claim leadership of the Hand, and works under her in #7 and #8.
In Defenders #8 Elektra apologizes to Matt for the pain she caused, says they are together now, and they kiss as Midland Circle collapses; enemy turns back to partner.
In Defenders #5 Elektra knocks Murakami aside to keep him from killing Matt, and Murakami then turns the other leaders against relying on her, before the #6 takeover.
In DD S2#10 Elektra kills an assassin Stick sent; in #11 and #12 they try to kill each other until Daredevil stops them. A clear turn to enemies.
In DD S2#12, still bent on killing Stick, Elektra refuses the Hand and helps Stick escape; the new text is true and marks the turn back.
They meet in S3 (#16 and #17); in S3#20 Coulson greets the returning Yo-Yo with Talbot and at his request she steals Talbot's medals with her speed. All before S4#3.
In DD S1#9 Elena is stabbed to death by a junkie paid by Fisk's men, and Karen, Foggy and Matt are called to the morgue to identify her body. A death is a stage.
In DD S1#9 Elena is killed on Fisk's men's orders and Karen, Foggy and Matt identify her body at the morgue.

Kilgrave controlled the whole 15th Precinct and never knew Costa; Costa was one officer in a crowd, is never on screen with him, and only recounts it later. The rules make this knowing about him, not a connection, and nightmares are not huge consequences.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
value.text: Enoch and his men burst into the diner where Yo-Yo and the team wait to be arrested, and he freezes them all and has them taken away.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A stranger who freezes Yo-Yo and the team in a diner and takes them away.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Enoch freezes and takes from a diner, along with her team.

verdicts.why: Enoch is on screen in S4#22: he greets Coulson, freezes the team (Yo-Yo included) at Rae's Restaurant and has them taken. The connection clearly starts there, so it gets a stage there; the S5#1 stage (which re-shows the abduction and sends them to 2091) can stay.

The Flint in S6#11 and #12 is a new being Izel makes Yo-Yo and Mack create from their memories (Fandom keeps him as a separate 'Monolith Recreation'), not the Flint Yo-Yo knew, so like an L.M.D. or Framework version he gets no stage.
In S4#22 the real Radcliffe's mind, trapped in the Framework, saves Yo-Yo from a Hydra agent in the Triskelion, takes her to Mack, and is deleted with the Framework.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
value.text: A year after the war, Yo-Yo leads a S.H.I.E.L.D. team made up of Piper and an L.M.D. of Davis.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Friend from the Zephyr, later on Yo-Yo's own team.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Friend from the Zephyr, later Piper's team leader.

verdicts.why: In S7#13 Yo-Yo does lead a team of Piper and the L.M.D. Davis, but the closing scene is set one year later, not 'years'.
World's End (S4#22) shows Enoch greet 'Phillip J. Coulson', freeze the team and order them taken, so the connection starts there; S5#1 can stay.

The Coulson in S7 is a Chronicom L.M.D., not the person, so by the ruling there is no stage for him: stage 2 should be dropped, not retold. (Stage 1, building an L.M.D. of the dead Coulson, has the same problem.)
In S6#5 Enoch tells Atarah to put Jemma in danger to motivate Fitz, and in S6#6 he deactivates Atarah and the hunters and teleports Jemma and Fitz out; a betrayal and rescue before S6#13.
In S6#5 Enoch admits to Fitz he offered Jemma up and a furious Fitz orders him out of his cell; in S6#6 Enoch turns on his people and rescues them both.
Enoch (the 2091 version, Fandom's Enoch/Destroyed Earth) does rescue May on the ruined surface in S5#7 'Together or Not at All'; the checker only looked at the main-timeline page.

In S7#2 May stabs Enoch with his own sedative, and when he draws an I.C.E.R. to keep her aboard she beats him badly and calls him just a machine until Coulson stops her; nothing there makes them trusted friends.
